author: Rivzz
body:
Hey everyone :D,

    I am going to work on a project, which will utilize 'DTM' in its core. Would anyone have any links to maps that I could possibly download, and furthermore is it possible for me to obtain some old Avicus maps? If I have to ask the creator for permission I'll gladly do so!

Regards,
Rivzz

replies.body:
Depending on your use for the maps, MapStack has a few Avicus maps there - https://mcresourcepile.github.io/mapstack/avicus

If you had to ask me if they were old though, I'm not all that sure (plus what Piez said, I guess it counts what you think is "old")
